cards.title: My son is leaving home for university
cards.body: A parent grapples with empty nest emotions as their first-born heads off to university. The reality of this life milestone hits harder than expected, challenging assumptions about how nature intended this transition.

cards.title: I forgot everything about having a second baby
cards.body: A new mother discovers how much she's forgotten about infant care between children—from feeding to teething to developmental milestones. Her own mother's practical support helps bridge the gap while stirring up memories of her blissfully low-key childhood.

cards.title: Should we let AI do parenting for us?
cards.body: Tech companies are offering AI tools for parenting like eye-movement trackers and optimized nap predictions, but are these really necessary? The article questions whether technology is solving real problems or creating new ones for already-stretched parents.

cards.title: The '18 summers' parenting trend questioned
cards.body: An author critiques the modern parenting obsession with structuring every summer moment as a memory-making opportunity. She argues unscheduled free time is what childhood needs, not another scheduled activity.

cards.title: Parenting considerations for raising gifted children
cards.body: Gifted children face unique challenges in school that differ significantly from their peers. Understanding these differences is essential for parents supporting advanced learners.

cards.title: Vapes could lead to health harms in children
cards.body: The Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health has published a report warning about vaping risks for young people. Doctors express concern that vaping may act as a gateway to traditional smoking.

cards.title: Young carers face huge disadvantages growing up
cards.body: A 17-year-old explains the significant sacrifices and challenges of being a young carer. Children in caregiving roles struggle to balance schooling, social life, and their responsibilities.
